title: GOV.UK: Apply for a Standard Visitor visa
before: Apply online from outside the UK, up to 3 months before you travel. You create a UKVI account with your email; your progress saves as you go.
Dates on GOV.UK are three boxes: day, month, year. The dates below are written in that order.
Have your passport, the documents on your checklist and a card for the £135 fee ready.

sections.title: Your name and contact details

fields.label: Email address
fields.note: Use an email you check. UKVI sends your decision here.

yourself: Whether you have used other names
How long you have lived at your address and whether you own or rent it

sections.title: Passport and nationality
yourself: National identity card number, if you have one

sections.title: Employment and money

fields.label: Who is paying for your trip

yourself: Your employer's phone number and your start date
Savings and how much you spend each month

sections.title: Family
yourself: Your parents' names, dates of birth and nationalities
Your partner's and children's details, if any
Whether you have family in the UK

sections.title: Travel and immigration history

fields.label: Been to the UK in the last 10 years

yourself: Countries you visited in the last 10 years, with dates
Criminal record, immigration breaches and character questions

after: Pay the £135 fee and, if offered, choose a priority service.
Book a biometrics appointment at the visa application centre (TLScontact or VFS Global, depending on your country) and bring your passport and documents.
Use the print-ready packet from Ta'asheera so your documents are in order at the appointment.
A decision usually comes within 3 weeks of your appointment. Record it on your dashboard when it arrives.
